noun_definition: Money refers to the amount of currency, specifically MYR (Malaysian Ringgit), that is being sent in a transaction, which in this case is incorrectly displayed as RM900.00 instead of the intended RM9.00.
Digit refers to the numerical characters that represent the amount of money being sent, specifically indicating the value before the decimal point in the transaction.

Decimal point refers to the symbol used to separate the whole number part from the fractional part of a monetary value, which in this Issue context is incorrectly positioned, leading to an erroneous display of the amount sent.
